parameter_provenance.manuscript_and_author: 200^3, labels 0/1/2, voxel size 0.7 um, random walk 3000 walkers / 5000 steps / stride 10 / union mask
parameter_provenance.existing_demo_and_api_defaults: Other numerical settings are carried over from CemCT_Demonstration.ipynb or package defaults. The final reproduction configuration has been explicitly fixed and run on the supplied experimental data; historical settings are not inferred solely from matching rounded values.
parameter_provenance.seed: deterministic_seed is the PyTrax Boolean debugging-seed option, not a user-selected integer seed.
parameter_provenance.full_interval_fit: All 500 saved time points (steps 0 to 4990 inclusive, stride 10) are used in a through-origin fit. This is the full-interval convention also used by the older notebook through PyTrax plot_msd. On the supplied experimental data, the resulting directional tortuosities round to 5.0, 5.7 and 4.6. The author approved this setting for the updated reproduction package and manuscript.
